card_library.name: Freddy "Boom Boom" Couples
card_library.rules: The golfer you select receives -1 stroke for each drive hit 350 yards or further on the final day of the tournament.

card_library.name: Bad Bounce
card_library.rules: Choose any opponent, their selected golfer receives a 5% penalty to their prize money this tournament.

card_library.name: Nasty Rash
card_library.rules: Curse an opposing player with a truly nasty rash. The sheer ferocity of the chaffing drives them to madness. Costing them 2 strokes over the course of the tournament. At the end of the tournament the rash spreads to any players who miss the cut. The rash contagion is temporarily cured for all Majors.
card_library.flavor: The type you don't even dare to scratch

card_library.name: Lucky Hop
card_library.rules: Boost your selected golfers winnings by 5% this tournament.

card_library.name: The Golden Bear
card_library.rules: This card may be played in Majors. This card must be played before the tournament but is not revealed until the conclusion of round 3. For each birdie or better your selected golfer makes on day 4 of the tournament their score is reduced by 1/2 stroke (rounded down)
card_library.flavor: "Nicklaus, the all time Major Tournament wins leader, is out of the cage..."

card_library.name: Found Lost Ball
card_library.rules: Your next booster pack contains an additional card. The card has a 30% chance to be rare and a 5% chance to be legendary.
card_library.flavor: It's not a Pro V1 but it will do...

card_library.name: Found a ProV1
card_library.rules: You found a like-new Titleist in the fescue! Your next booster pack contains a additional card that is guaranteed to be at least rare. The card has a 30% chance to be legendary and 5% chance to be mythic!

card_library.name: BURNhard Langer
card_library.rules: This card can be played in majors. Bernhard Langer enters the field this weekend. ALL other golfers receive a 1 stroke penalty at the start of the 4th round. This card is not revealed until that point.
card_library.flavor: "Be decisive. A wrong decision is generally less disastrous than indecision."

card_library.name: Pooped Your Pants!
card_library.rules: A bad case of diarrhea sneaks up on a randomly chosen player this week. That player receives a 1 stroke penalty at the start of the tournament. Be careful, it could be you who is chosen! If anyone chose Patrick Reed he receives this debuff automatically.
card_library.flavor: It happens to the best of us...

card_library.name: Broken Tee
card_library.rules: It's not a big deal, but it was your favorite tee. A randomly chosen opponent receives a 5% earnings penalty in this weekend's tournament.

card_library.name: Sam Sneed
card_library.rules: Play this on an opponent of your choice. Steal 100% of their winning for yourself this tournament.
card_library.flavor: His rythmic tempo allowed him to win PGA Tour events across six different decades.

card_library.name: Gimme
card_library.rules: Your golfer's round 1 score improves by 1 stroke.
card_library.flavor: Inside the leather. Just pick it up.

card_library.name: Range Ball
card_library.rules: Your golfer's prize money is boosted 3% this tournament.
card_library.flavor: Cut, scuffed, striped, and still better than yours.

card_library.name: Sandbagger
card_library.rules: If your golfer makes the cut but finishes outside the top 40, earn a $150,000 bonus.

card_library.name: Cart Path Only
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. Their golfer loses 3% for every bogey in round 4, up to 15%.

card_library.name: Sunday Red
card_library.rules: If your golfer posts the lowest round 4 among all league picks, earn a 10% bonus.
card_library.flavor: It was never about the shirt.

card_library.name: Greenside Bunker
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. If their golfer bogeys the 18th hole on any day, they take a 5% penalty.
card_library.flavor: Plugged. Fried egg. Sunny side down.

card_library.name: The Yips
card_library.rules: A randomly chosen opponent's golfer takes a 1 stroke penalty in round 3.
card_library.flavor: It's in your head. Now it's in your hands.

card_library.name: Caddie's Advice
card_library.rules: Before lock, learn one opponent's current pick.

card_library.name: Local Knowledge
card_library.rules: If your golfer has won this event before, earn a 10% bonus.
card_library.flavor: He knows where the bodies are buried. Mostly his own.

card_library.name: Rain Delay
card_library.rules: Play before lock. Everyone's Instant window closes 8 hours early this week.

card_library.name: Weekend Warrior
card_library.rules: If your golfer shoots under par in both weekend rounds, earn an 8% bonus.

card_library.name: Practice Swing
card_library.rules: Your next booster pack contains one extra Common.
card_library.flavor: Looked great. The real one didn't.

card_library.name: Shank
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. If their golfer makes a double bogey or worse this tournament, they lose 5%.

card_library.name: Free Relief
card_library.rules: Cancel one stroke penalty applied to your golfer this tournament.

card_library.name: Fore Left!
card_library.rules: A randomly chosen opponent takes a 2% penalty.

card_library.name: Birdie Juice
card_library.rules: Earn $25,000 for every birdie your golfer makes in round 1, up to $200,000.

card_library.name: Three-Putt
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. Their golfer takes a 1 stroke penalty in round 2.

card_library.name: Tap-In
card_library.rules: Your golfer's round 4 score improves by 1 stroke.
card_library.flavor: Never up, never in. This one's up.

card_library.name: Cut Line
card_library.rules: If your golfer makes the cut on the number, earn a 15% bonus.
card_library.flavor: Living on the edge. Sleeping in the car.

card_library.name: Made the Bar
card_library.rules: If your golfer misses the cut, earn $100,000 anyway.

card_library.name: Marker's Error
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. Their golfer takes a 1 stroke penalty in round 1.

card_library.name: Extra Tee
card_library.rules: You have 4 tees this tournament instead of 3.
card_library.flavor: Found it in the cup holder.

card_library.name: Breakfast Ball
card_library.rules: Your first card next tournament costs 1 tee less.

card_library.name: Lift, Clean and Place
card_library.rules: Your golfer's worst round this tournament counts 1 stroke better.

card_library.name: Gallery Heckler
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. Their golfer takes a 1 stroke penalty in round 4.

card_library.name: Back Nine Charge
card_library.rules: If your golfer finishes higher than he started round 4, earn an 8% bonus.
card_library.flavor: The tournament starts on the back nine Sunday.

card_library.name: Slow Play Warning
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. They cannot play Instants this tournament.
card_library.flavor: On the clock. In your place.

card_library.name: Sponsor's Exemption
card_library.rules: Your golfer's prize money counts at the tournament multiplier plus 0.1.

card_library.name: Pro-Am Hangover
card_library.rules: A randomly chosen opponent's golfer takes a 1 stroke penalty in round 1.

card_library.name: Ham and Egg
card_library.rules: Choose a partner. Whoever's golfer earns less receives 10% of the other's prize money.
card_library.flavor: One of us had to show up.

card_library.name: Fescue
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. Their golfer loses 4% for each round over par, up to 12%.

card_library.name: Clubhouse Leader
card_library.rules: Earn $75,000 for each completed round your golfer leads or co-leads.

card_library.name: Provisional
card_library.rules: If your golfer withdraws or is disqualified, you receive the average prize money of the league's picks instead.

card_library.name: Grip It and Rip It
card_library.rules: Earn $20,000 for every eagle your golfer makes this tournament.

card_library.name: Two-Club Wind
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. Each of their golfer's over-par rounds counts 1 stroke worse, up to 2.
card_library.flavor: Hit the knockdown. Hit it again.

card_library.name: Course Record
card_library.rules: If your golfer posts the low round of the day in any round, earn a 10% bonus.

card_library.name: Cart Girl
card_library.rules: Earn a $50,000 bonus this tournament.

card_library.name: Snowman
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. If their golfer makes an 8 or worse on any hole, they lose 10%.

card_library.name: Even Par
card_library.rules: If your golfer finishes the tournament at exactly even par, earn a 20% bonus.

card_library.name: Trunk Slammer
card_library.rules: Choose an opponent. If their golfer misses the cut, they take an extra $50,000 fine.
